name: Game End Upgrades
placementTarget: Reference sheet. The four tower icons on it are the stickers that go on the board. This sheet itself is not a board sticker.
text:
GAME END UPGRADES

[four satellite-dish icons]
[an orange circle with 3 under each icon]

PERMANENT SATELLITE TOWERS
Put a Permanent Satellite Tower sticker next to a city
that had a satellite tower in the just-played game.
During setup, add a satellite tower to each city with
a Permanent Satellite Tower sticker.

mechanics.timing: Game end, when placing permanent satellite towers. Also read at the start of later games, during setup.
mechanics.effect: Explains the four Permanent Satellite Tower stickers. Each is marked 3. Place one next to a city that had a satellite tower in the game just played. In later setup, add a satellite tower miniature to every city that has the sticker.
restrictions: The sticker records a tower from the game just finished, not a tower you wish the city had.
Four stickers, so at most four cities keep a tower this way.
